record.question: What is the maximum initial period for which full Daily Allowance may be drawn in case of temporary transfer?
record.explanation: Full daily allowance on temporary transfer is drawable for an initial period of 180 days under the FR & SR rules, after which it reduces. The stem and options are clear, and 180 days is the chosen option.

record.paperId: Old_Questions/LDE_2021-2022/LDE Inspector of Police (MUC) under Home Deptt. Paper-II.pdf
record.question: Which of the following statement is correct?
options: TA may also be given to a Government servant who has undergone training at headquarters.
A Government servant on probation may be given T.A. at par with a confirmed Government servant.
T.A. may be given to a Government servant for enforced halts while on tour.
A Government servant under suspension should not be given T.A. for journey performed for giving evidence.
record.explanation: TA is admissible for enforced halts while on tour, which is the correct statement among the four printed options. Other options restrict TA for probationers, suspended officers or training at headquarters.
